items.title: Merz pledges further support for Ukraine’s air defense and energy sector ahead of winter

items.title: Mostly elderly people injured in Russian strike on hospital in Kharkiv
items.teaser: A Russian overnight strike on a medical facility in Kharkiv left 73 people injured, the vast majority of whom are elderly patients suffering from acute stress.

items.title: Ukraine, allies to coordinate peace efforts ahead of planned talks with Russia
items.teaser: The European Commission will host talks on Ukraine in Brussels on Nov. 4, bringing together representatives from the U.S., Ukraine, NATO, and several European countries.

items.title: Overnight Russian shelling damages three medical facilities and 17 apartment buildings in Kharkiv
items.teaser: As a result of Russia’s nighttime attack on Kharkiv in the Nemyshlianskyi District, three medical facilities and 17 high-rise residential buildings were damaged.

items.title: Kyiv deploying heating centres amid extremely difficult power situation

items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute auf einer gemeinsamen Pressekonferenz mit Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz in Berlin, dass die amerikanische Seite beim trilateralen Treffen in Abu Dhabi die Sicherheitsgarantien und das Wiederaufbaupaket zur Sprache bringen wolle. items.teaser: Rede des ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf der Berliner Sicherheitskonferenz (BSC)

items.title: Kyiv mayor explains power and water outages following Russian strikes on capital's energy hub
items.teaser: Kyiv Mayor Vitalii Klitschko has explained that emergency power outages, transport and water supply issues in the capital were caused by Russian attacks on the regional energy hub.

items.title: Four boats, two soldiers each, under cover of fog: Russia’s first attempt to land troops in Kherson ended with one dead and three captured
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Southern Defense Forces say Russia is preparing a bridgehead at Kherson’s Korabel district to try to retake the city.

items.title: Merz verspricht mehr Hilfe für die Ukraine und appelliert an Europäer
items.teaser: Russische Angriffe auf die Energie-Infrastruktur, Raketeneinschläge in den Städten: Der Ukraine droht ein harter Kriegswinter. Kanzler Merz sagt Unterstützung zu - fordert aber auch mehr Engagement der europäischen Partner.

items.title: Kyiv faces emergency power cuts, widespread water outages after Russia's largest attack on energy infrastructure this year
items.teaser: The widespread power and water outages in Kyiv follow Russia's largest mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure this year, which targeted substations, transmission systems, and power plants across the country.

items.title: Selenskyj besucht Merz, Schaeffler spart, Midterms laufen
items.teaser: Selenskyj stimmt sich mit Merz in Berlin ab, der Autozulieferer Schaeffler baut Tausende Jobs ab und in den USA laufen die Midterms. Der Tag.

items.title: Merz announces November 19 meeting of Coalition of the Willing in Berlin
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has announced that an in-person meeting of the leaders of the countries participating in the Coalition of the Willing will take place in Berlin on November 19. They are expected to agree on the scale of further support for Ukraine in 2027, primarily military assistance.

items.title: Öltanklager in Region Samara brennt den zweiten Tag in Folge
items.teaser: Ein Brand in einem der größten Tanklager Europas, der linearen Produktions- und Verteilstation (LVDS) „Samara“ in dem Dorf Proswet, Region Samara, wütet nun schon den zweiten Tag.

items.title: Norway, Denmark and Sweden teams refuse to play with Russia at 2027 Ice Hockey World Cup
items.teaser: Russia returns to international ice hockey, and sponsors walk out. A Swedish firm ends a sponsorship it has held since 1989.

items.title: Top European nations vow to boycott Ice Hockey World Championship if Russia returns
items.teaser: "Allowing Russia to participate will have significant consequences in terms of security, politically and economically for us as hosts,” the German Ice Hockey Federation (DEB) said in a statement.

items.title: SSU identifies around 100 people involved in unrest in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has identified around 100 people who were present during the unrest in the village of Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, Kyiv region, on November 2, including those actively involved in organizing it.

items.title: German chancellor: If Putin is invited to G20 summit, Zelenskyy must be there too
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says Ukraine must be represented if Trump invites Putin to the G20 summit in Miami.

items.title: Woman, 22, with 81% burns in critical condition after Komyshuvakha attack
items.teaser: Four people injured in the Russian attack on Komyshuvakha are in hospital. A 22-year-old woman with burns covering 81% of her body is in intensive care.

items.title: $400 billion US tech giant helping Ukraine is now facing backlash on both sides of Atlantic
items.teaser: European governments are moving to cut their reliance on the US under Trump's administation.

items.title: Zelensky outlines key topics for trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that during the trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi, the U.S. side plans to discuss security guarantees and a Recovery Package. Ukraine is also interested in discussing an energy ceasefire, unblocking the Black Sea, exchanges, and preparations for a meeting of the leaders of Ukraine, the U

items.title: One killed and five injured as Russian forces strike Kramatorsk suburb with aerial bombs – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces have dropped four guided aerial bombs on the settlement of Yasnohirka, a suburb of Kramatorsk in Donetsk Oblast, killing one person and injuring five others

items.title: Treffen im Kanzleramt: Merz und Selenskyj beraten über Ukraine-Unterstützung
items.teaser: Treffen im Kanzleramt: Merz und Selenskyj beraten über Ukraine-Unterstützung

items.teaser: Ukraine's national energy company Ukrenergo has reported that one of the most massive Russian attacks on the country's energy infrastructure is currently ongoing

items.title: Selenskyj meldet 33 Tote in Komyschuwacha
items.teaser: In Komyschuwacha (eine Siedlung städtischen Typs im Süden der ukrainischen Region Saporischschja) ist die Zahl der Todesopfer durch den russischen Luftangriff auf 33 gestiegen. Mehr als 50 Menschen werden möglicherweise noch unter Trümmern vermutet.

items.title: Ukraine war: Merz doubts Russia is serious about a truce
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz met with Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Berlin. Both leaders said the EU needs to be included in peace talks with Russia. Merz also expressed doubts that Russia is serious about seeking a truce.

items.title: Zelensky announces meetings of U.S., European and Ukrainian teams in Brussels
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that meetings involving teams from Ukraine, the United States, Europe and NATO countries will be held in Brussels tomorrow, November 4, to discuss recovery packages and security guarantees.

items.title: A logistics general takes over Ukraine’s state arms group, and the company is counting on him to make it build more
items.teaser: The new chief steps in after months with a stand-in at the top, while Ukraine’s arms industry can build far more than the state budget buys from it.

items.title: Zelenskyy on talks with Putin: I don't want to listen to history lectures over the phone
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that he sees no sense in a phone conversation with Russian leader Vladimir Putin, preferring to work out real steps towards peace.

items.title: Russians drop four aerial bombs on Kramatorsk, killing one and injuring five
items.teaser: In the Donetsk region, Russian forces dropped four aerial bombs on the outskirts of Kramatorsk, killing one person and injuring five others.

items.title: Selenskyj trifft Merz in Berlin
items.teaser: Besuch des ukrainischen Präsidenten in Berlin: Pressekonferenz mit Merz und Selenskyj

items.title: Survival is 'just a bonus' — Inside one of the Ukrainian army's most dangerous jobs
items.teaser: Where it was previously common for reconnaissance soldiers to wait for hours, sometimes days, just steps away from Russian positions to collect information, such as ammunition delivery schedules. Today, their work includes ambushing the enemy, countering Russian infiltrators, and clearing out Russian positions.

items.title: Special emergency power cuts introduced in two oblasts
items.teaser: A special emergency power cut schedule has been introduced in Sumy and Poltava oblasts. The utilities say they cannot tell consumers how long the power cuts will last.

items.title: Budget 2027 being prepared for second reading with IMF cooperation in mind: PM Koretskyi, lawmakers hold meeting
items.teaser: A meeting was held on preparing the 2027 state budget for its second reading, attended by Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi, parliamentary leadership, the head of the Servant of the People parliamentary faction, the chair of the Verkhovna Rada Budget Committee, and Finance Minister Serhii Marchenko.

items.title: What US midterm elections mean for Ukraine, Iran and elsewhere
items.teaser: Donald Trump's Republicans control the US Congress, but that could change after the midterm elections. The outcome of the ballot will not only impact domestic policy but also conflicts in Europe and the Middle East.

items.title: Vassili Golod, ARD Kiew, zu Selenskyjs Staatsbesuch in Berlin
items.teaser: Vassili Golod, ARD Kiew, zu Selenskyjs Staatsbesuch in Berlin

items.title: German chancellor says peace talks impossible without Europe's participation
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says Europe must take part in talks involving Ukraine, the US and Russia, arguing that a peace deal cannot be reached without European involvement.

items.title: Russische Armee wirft vier Gleitbomben auf Kramatorsker Vorort: Ein Toter, fünf Verletzte
items.teaser: In der Region Donezk warf die russische Armee vier Gleitbomben auf den Vorort von Kramatorsk ab. Dabei wurde ein Mensch getötet und fünf weitere verletzt, teilte die Staatsanwaltschaft der Region Donezk bei Telegram mit.

items.title: Polish firms prepare to build Ukraine’s Bohdana away from Russia’s front—Kramatorsk’s howitzer heads west
items.teaser: Ukraine's main self-propelled gun is getting a Polish truck integrator and a Polish-led maker for the next stage of the war.

items.title: Melania Trump to convene Russian and Ukrainian representatives at White House
items.teaser: U.S. First Lady Melania Trump will host a meeting at the White House involving representatives of Ukraine and Russia to discuss the ceasefire in Oleshky, Kherson region.

items.title: Europe’s future force for Ukraine from 11 countries will hold its first rehearsal in Poland—for a peace that doesn’t exist yet
items.teaser: 2,800 troops will train about 100 km from the Ukrainian border.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strike on Komyshuvakha reaches 33, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced that the death toll from a Russian aerial bomb strike on the settlement of Komyshuvakha has reached 33.

items.title: Ukraine's ombudsman, sanctioned Russian commissioner invited to Melania Trump's White House event, source says
items.teaser: The White House announced on Nov. 3 that representatives from Ukraine and Russia would join the first lady for her remarks on the humanitarian operation in Oleshky.

items.title: Water supply disrupted in Kyiv
items.teaser: Russian attacks have knocked out power to key water supply facilities in Kyiv, causing disruptions to the city's water supply.

items.title: Russian forces attack civilians on road in Sumy region with drones, woman injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked civilians with drones on a road in the Velyka Pysarivka community of the Okhtyrka district, seriously injuring a woman.

items.title: Russian drone strikes house in Kyiv Oblast, killing 14-year-old
items.teaser: A drone has hit a house in Khotiv, Kyiv Oblast, completely destroying it, killing a child and injuring one of the parents. Firefighters are working at the scene.

items.title: Former deputy defense minister appointed to lead Ukraine's state-run defense giant
items.teaser: Lieutenant General Ivan Havryliuk, a former first deputy defense minister, has been appointed to lead Ukroboronprom, Ukraine's largest state-owned defense company, according to a Nov. 3 statement.

items.title: In Region Kyjiw trifft russische Drohne ein Privathaus und tötet ein Kind
items.teaser: Ein 14-jähriges Kind kam bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff in der Region Kyjiw ums Leben.

items.title: US first lady to bring together Ukrainian and Russian representatives at White House
items.teaser: US First Lady Melania Trump is set to personally arrange a meeting between Russian and Ukrainian representatives in the United States.

items.title: Russian drones watch the roads in Donetsk Oblast, but not the nearly 6 km route Ukraine has set up underground
items.teaser: Troops ride motorcycles and quad bikes through it, and wounded soldiers are evacuated through it too.

items.title: Hungary has no new substantive objections to opening Ukraine’s final negotiation clusters – Kachka
items.teaser: The Hungarian authorities have no new substantive objections to opening the two remaining negotiating clusters on Ukraine’s accession to the European Union.

items.title: Poland reports suspicious activity by "people with torches" on border with Russia
items.teaser: Prime Minister Donald Tusk has said Polish forces prevented a suspected provocation after the Border Guard spotted people with flashlights near the Russian border, amid sabotage warnings.

items.title: Russian drone hits house in Kyiv region, 14-year-old child killed
items.teaser: A 14-year-old child was killed in a Russian drone strike in the Kyiv region.

items.title: Charkiw erlebte im Oktober Rekordzahl an russischen Angriffen – Bürgermeister
items.teaser: Im vergangenen Monat habe der Luftalarm in Charkiw 444 Stunden gedauert – insgesamt also mehr als 18 Tage, schreibt der Bürgermeister der Stadt, Ihor Terechow, auf Telegram.

items.title: General Staff responds to events in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka
items.teaser: Following the events in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, the General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces stressed that the processes of joining the military and returning service members after unauthorized absence from their units must be carried out in accordance with the law and with respect for human dignity.

items.title: Fear of Ukraine’s mobilization keeps some people under Russian occupation, and Moscow uses it as a psyop, MP says. His deferment bill has stalled
items.teaser: Kherson Oblast’s former head says some who do return face a fine for not passing a draft medical board they had no way to attend.

items.title: Russian attacks across Ukraine kill 38, injure 167, as Russia hits Dnipro hospitals in morning missile strike
items.teaser: The Air Force said Russia launched an unspecified number of ballistic missiles, including the Iskander-M, North Korean KN-23, and Zircon types, in addition to 59 cruise missiles and 289 attack drones against Ukraine overnight, mostly targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Vinnytsia oblasts.

items.title: Ukraine's envoy to EU says Hungary has raised no new objections to negotiating clusters being opened for Ukraine
items.teaser: Taras Kachka, Ukraine's representative to the EU, has stated that Hungary has not raised any new objections to the opening of the final two clusters in Ukraine’s accession talks.

items.title: Russian forces attack agricultural enterprise in Zhytomyr region, three injured
items.teaser: Russian drones have attacked an agricultural enterprise in the Liubar community in the Zhytomyr region, injuring three people.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Russland bombardiert Krankenhaus in Charkiw
items.teaser: Russland setzt seine Angriffe auf die Ukraine fort: Nach einem Hilfsgüter-Verteilzentrum am Montag wurden heute medizinische Einrichtungen und Energieanlagen bombardiert. Präsident Selenskyj ist zu einem Besuch in Berlin eingetroffen.

items.title: Kill the archer, not the arrows: Ukraine asked Trump again and again to free Starshield against Russia’s ballistic launchers
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president argues that hunting the launchers inside Russia would save more lives than waiting for Patriot interceptors that will never be enough.

items.title: Zelensky, Merz hold talks in Berlin
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with German Federal Chancellor Friedrich Merz in Berlin on Tuesday, November 3.

items.title: Meeting on security guarantees for Ukraine to take place on 4 November
items.teaser: A meeting to discuss security guarantees for Ukraine will be held at the European Commission headquarters in Brussels on 4 November, ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Feuer und Explosionen nach Treffer auf Stützpunkt russischer Einheit, die Krim-Brücke bewacht
items.teaser: In Kertsch auf der anektierten Krim ist ein Stüptzpunkt russischer Invasoren, die Krim-Brücke bewachen, angegriffen worden.

items.title: Zelenskyy confirms Ukraine hacked Russian warning system in retaliation
items.teaser: Following unauthorised alerts regarding radiation threats in Ukraine, President Zelenskyy has confirmed Kyiv struck back against Russia's emergency systems.

items.title: Kremlin sees “no similar plans” after Oleshky—Kyiv plans to set up a center to return civilians Russia holds
items.teaser: Families of detained Ukrainians will get one office to turn to, the ombudsman says. Russia will have no part in building it.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Berlin.

items.title: Search and rescue operation completed in Dnipro, two killed and 20 injured
items.teaser: Emergency services have completed search operations in Dnipro, treating 14 hospital patients – including three in a serious condition – following extensive infrastructure strikes.

items.title: Zelensky confirms resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries
items.teaser: Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to continued Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

items.title: Russia ends free bottled gas for 13 groups of Crimeans before winter. In one village, a gas cylinder costs up to four times the official price—a local resident
items.teaser: Prices have risen for every fuel Crimeans use to heat homes during power outages, Crimean media report.

items.title: Zelenskyy and his team arrive in Berlin
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has arrived in Berlin, where he is due to meet Friedrich Merz, Frank-Walter Steinmeier and Julia Klöckner and attend the Berlin Security Conference.

items.title: Russia unleashes biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy this year
items.teaser: Energy officials recorded one of the largest waves of Russian ballistic missiles targeting critical infrastructure, with Russia also launching cruise missiles, jet-powered drones, and propeller-powered drones, Vitalii Zaichenko, CEO of Ukrenergo, the country's state grid operator, told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: Warnungen vor Sabotage und bewaffneten Eindringlingen: Polen stationiert Anti-Terror-Polizei nahe der russischen Grenze
items.teaser: Polen verstärkt seine Sicherheitsmaßnahmen an der Grenze zu Kaliningrad. Hintergrund sind Warnungen vor möglichen Sabotageakten und dem Eindringen bewaffneter Gruppen.

items.title: Russian forces may be planning new landing attempts in Kherson's Korabel district – South Group of Forces
items.teaser: Russian troops are making preparations that may indicate an intention to establish a foothold on the right bank of the Dnipro River in the Kherson region, build up forces in the Korabel district of Kherson, and use it as a potential bridgehead for further operations aimed at capturing the city.

items.title: Handy-Spionage verhindern: Diese Maßnahmen schützen Sie
items.teaser: Von heimlicher Standortüberwachung bis zum Mitlesen von Nachrichten: Schon einfache Maßnahmen können verhindern, dass Fremde Ihr Smartphone ausspähen.

items.title: Drei Wärmekraftwerke stellen nach russischen Angriffen Betrieb ein
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den 3. November haben die Russen drei Wärmekraftwerke der DTEK-Gruppe angegriffen.

items.title: Ukraine hacked Russia's emergency alert system in response to Russian cyberattack – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine hacked Russia's emergency alert system in response to a Russian cyberattack on November 1. The hack was a response to Russia sending fake nuclear threat warnings to Ukrainian users.

items.title: Russia kept troops at an aviation school beside Luhansk’s dead airfield. A week after the last strike, Ukraine hit the area again
items.teaser: The first attack lasted for hours and hit the city’s power, and this time Ukrainian monitors caught the fire on video from the edge of town.

items.title: 2060 Soldaten: Russlands Verluste seit gestern
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 594. 830 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 2 060.

items.title: Death toll from Komyshuvakha airstrike rises to 31, nearly 50 people missing
items.teaser: A search-and-rescue operation is underway at the site of an airstrike in Komyshuvakha. So far, 31 people have been confirmed killed, while nearly 50 others are missing.

items.title: Hours before Americans vote, Russia fires 59 cruise missiles at Ukraine’s grid and bombs a Kharkiv hospital
items.teaser: Missiles and drones went after power plants and substations, and a guided bomb landed between two hospital buildings in Kharkiv.

items.title: Russian attack hits energy infrastructure in 10 regions – Energy Ministry
items.teaser: Russia's large-scale missile and drone attack targeted power plants, substations and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) across 10 Ukrainian regions. Emergency power outages were introduced in Kyiv and six regions as a result of the damage.

items.title: Ukraine-Krieg: USA bringen Moskau und Kyjiw an einen Tisch
items.teaser: Im zähen diplomatischen Ringen um ein Ende des russischen Angriffskriegs gegen die Ukraine könnte es bald etwas Bewegung geben. Die Multinationale Ukraine-Truppe konzentriert sich bereits auf die Friedenssicherung.

items.title: Three DTEK power plants halt generation after large-scale Russian attack
items.teaser: Three thermal power plants operated by DTEK Group were targeted in a Russian attack overnight into November 3.

items.title: FM Sybiha calls Russia’s deliberate pre-winter attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure clear sign of genocide
items.teaser: Russia’s targeted attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, aimed at depriving the population of electricity and heating on the eve of winter, are one of the direct signs of genocide.

items.title: Energieinfrastruktur in mehreren Regionen der Ukraine bei russischen Angriffen beschädigt
items.teaser: In der Nacht hat Russland mehrere Regionen der Ukraine mit massiven Luftangriffen überzogen. Im Visier stand vor allem Energieinfrastruktur.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian infrastructure in Chernihiv region early in morning
items.teaser: Early this morning, Russian troops launched a drone strike on a farm building and a house in one of the villages of the Kiptivka community in Chernihiv region.

items.title: Bereits 73 Verletzte nach russischem Angriff auf Krankenhaus in Charkiw
items.teaser: Durch einen russischen Angriff in der Nacht auf den 3. November auf ein Krankenhaus in Charkiw sind 73 Menschen verletzt worden, teilt das Büro des Generalstaatsanwalts auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 206 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die meisten - bei Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 206 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Telegram mit.

items.teaser: Russian troops damaged a DTEK Odesa Power Grid facility, causing power outages.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Russia launched 17 ballistic missiles against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has clarified that the Russians conducted attacks using 17 ballistic missiles among other weapons on the night of 2-3 November.

items.title: Zelensky to visit Berlin on Nov. 3, German chancellor says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky is due to visit Berlin on Nov. 3, according to German Chancellor Friedrich Merz.

items.title: Drone attack sparks fire at one of Russia’s largest oil refineries in Yaroslavl, media report

items.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy to make surprise Berlin visit this Tuesday, Merz says
items.teaser: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the Ukrainian president is due to arrive in Germany around midday amid a renewed push for peace talks with Moscow.

items.title: Merz kündigt Selenskyj-Besuch in Berlin an
items.teaser: Vor einer neuen Verhandlungsrunde mit Russland und den USA trifft Selenskyj Kanzler Merz in Berlin. Es geht um Sicherheitsgarantien, Flugabwehr und weitere Milliardenhilfen.

items.title: Eine der größten russischen Ölraffinerien brennt nach Drohnenangriff

Auf dem Gelände der Anlage, die unter anderem Treibstoff für Militärflugzeuge und -technik liefert, brach ein Feuer aus, wie der Telegram-Kanal ASTRA berichtet.

items.title: Kazakhstan suspends oil supplies to Russia amid drone attacks
items.teaser: Kazakhstan has temporarily suspended the transport of crude oil to Russia via the Atyrau–Samara pipeline following a drone attack on the morning of 2 November.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,594,830 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,060 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Russia strikes Ukrenergo substation in Rivne Oblast

items.title: Russian strike on Kharkiv hospital raises injury toll to 73
items.teaser: In Kharkiv, 73 people were injured as a result of a Russian attack on the night of November 3.

items.title: Ukraine, Iran und Co.: So könnten die Midterms die US-Außenpolitik beeinflussen

items.teaser: Ukraine will not release official figures on the number of citizens who have returned from Oleshky to territory controlled by Ukraine, or on those who have left for territory controlled by Russia, in accordance with agreements reached with the Russian side.

items.title: UK intercepts Russian spy ship monitoring NATO military exercises
items.teaser: British helicopters tracked a Russian intelligence ship, Viktor Leonov, as it was "closely monitoring" NATO military drills off the coast of Scotland, the Royal Navy said.

items.title: Ukraine turns old BTR into rolling bomb — then drove it straight into Russian lines, battalion commander says
items.teaser: A soldier once walked for days to fetch ammunition under watching drones.

items.title: Lubinets says further steps being prepared for humanitarian missions involving Russia: Ombudsmen appeal to Melania Trump
items.teaser: Ukrainian Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights Dmytro Lubinets has appealed to Melania Trump to extend the positive experience of Oleshky to other settlements.

items.title: Wie viele Menschen in Oleschky verblieben sind, lässt sich nicht feststellen – Lubinez
items.teaser: Es ist derzeit unmöglich, die genaue Anzahl der in Oleschky verbliebenen Personen festzustellen.

items.title: Lubinets: Ukraine leaves large amount of humanitarian aid in Oleshky for residents who remain in city
items.teaser: Ukraine has provided substantial humanitarian aid to the people who remained in Oleshky—food, water, medicine, fuel for generators, and specialized equipment for the hospital, which continues to operate in the city.

items.title: “By blocking Moldova, no one is helping Ukraine,” President Maia Sandu says, as both countries wait to open their two EU negotiation clusters
items.teaser: Moldova’s president stops short of splitting her EU bid from Ukraine’s, but says she answers for her own country’s progress.

items.title: Minefields kill 279 Russian troops on southern front in October – military
items.teaser: In October, Russian forces lost 279 servicemen and 60 pieces of weapons and military equipment after triggering mine and explosive barriers in the Huliaipole, Orikhiv and Oleksandrivka sectors of the front.

items.title: AfD und Linke: Warum Extremismus-Vergleiche zu kurz greifen
items.teaser: SPD und Grüne laufen Sturm gegen die Gleichsetzung von AfD und der Linken durch CDU und CSU. Experten betonen deutliche Unterschiede, vor allem bei Ideologie und Bewertung des Verfassungsschutzes. Von Jürgen P. Lang.

items.title: Russia steps up use of electronic warfare systems to disrupt Starlink in Crimea and on front line
items.teaser: Radio technology expert Serhii Beskrestnov has detailed how Russian troops camouflage Starlink-jamming equipment across Crimea and active combat zones

items.title: Russian drone attack on residential area in Sumy district kills one and injures another
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a drone attack on a residential area in the Mykolaiv community of the Sumy district; one person was killed and another was seriously injured.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief on talks with Russian counterpart: "I know no other way to bring back our citizens"
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, Ukrainian Parliamentary Human Rights Commissioner, has explained why he maintains diplomatic etiquette in negotiations with his Russian counterpart, Yana Lantratova.

items.title: Ukraine, EU split over US-backed plan to bring Russian gas back to Europe
items.teaser: The European Union is unlikely to accept a U.S. proposal to resume Russian gas deliveries to Europe through Ukraine, EU officials told the Kyiv Independent, despite Washington's belief that the scheme could help secure a ceasefire and provide economic benefits to Kyiv. The proposal would allow Russia

items.title: Jugendliche wegen möglicher Anschlagpläne in Verdacht
items.teaser: Die Strafverfolgungsbehörden in Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein ermitteln gegen einen Jugendlichen und einen jungen Mann wegen der möglichen Vorbereitung eines Anschlags.

items.title: Russia, accused of mass torture, withdraws from convention against torture
items.teaser: Committee President Alan Mitchell has lamented the end of the CPT's monitoring mandate as Russia's official denunciation of the treaty takes effect.

items.title: WSJ: US pitches Russian gas through Ukraine’s pipelines as Moscow’s incentive for an energy truce
items.teaser: Kyiv let Russian transit expire in January 2025. The EU’s full ban on Russian pipeline gas starts in autumn 2027.

items.title: Bodies of military personnel, civilians taken out of Oleshky during humanitarian mission – Lubinets
items.teaser: The bodies of deceased Ukrainian citizens, both military personnel and civilians, were taken out of Oleshky and nearby areas during the humanitarian mission.

items.title: Ukraine's human rights commissioner explains why people were not evacuated from Oleshky directly to Kherson
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said that a direct river crossing was ruled out to protect frontline positions and preserve Ukraine's defence capabilities.

items.title: Schauspieler Nikolaj Coster-Waldau fordert verstärkte Unterstützung für ukrainischen Energiesektor
items.teaser: Während seines Besuchs in der Ukraine rief der UN-Sonderbotschafter des Entwicklungsprogramms (UNDP) und dänische Schauspieler Nikolaj Coster-Waldau die internationalen Partner dazu auf, die finanzielle Unterstützung für ukrainische Gemeinden fortzusetzen und beim Wiederaufbau der Energieinfrastruktur vor dem Winter zu

items.title: US delivery of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine will span 3 years starting in 2030
items.teaser: Ukraine will be able to receive the 500 Patriot PAC-3 interceptor missiles approved by the US State Department between Q4 2030 and Q4 2033

items.title: Flash: Russia increases deployment of satellite-based EW systems targeting Starlink
items.teaser: Russian occupation forces are increasing the number of satellite electronic warfare (EW) systems that interfere with Starlink operations.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief says Russian equipment seen in video was used for mine clearance
items.teaser: Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said Russian heavy equipment seen in footage filmed during the Oleshky ceasefire was used exclusively for mine clearance under supervision.

items.title: One fatality, five injured in overnight fire at boarding facility near Kyiv
items.teaser: One person was found dead and five others injured in a fire at a boarding facility in the village of Sofiivska Borshchahivka, Bucha district, Kyiv region.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief says he and Russian counterpart have agreed to present joint proposal to Melania Trump
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets and Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova propose extending the Oleshky evacuation model to other frontline settlements.

items.title: The Oleshky truce saved hundreds, but Russia used it to bring fresh troops, armor, and fuel within nine kilometers of Kherson, marines say
items.teaser: Drone footage also shows bodies being carried out of the town’s hospital under Russian soldiers’ watch, and a journalist says 47 bodies from its basement were taken to occupied Henichesk.

items.title: Can AI tell the truth? How Russian propagandists are influencing ChatGPT
Russian FPV drones attack special-purpose vehicles near Kharkiv, killing one
items.teaser: A man was killed in a Russian FPV drone strike in the territory of the Malodanilivka territorial community in Kharkiv district.

items.title: “The days are long gone when EW complex looked like six trailers standing side by side”: Russia’s Starlink jammers go undercover, defense adviser says
items.teaser: Russia is building more jammers to blind Ukraine’s Starlink and hiding them. Serhii Beskrestnov suggests each covers 25 sq km and tells drone crews where to look.

items.title: Russischer Luftangriff auf Isjum: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf 15
items.teaser: Nach einem russischen Gleitbombenangriff auf die Stadt Isjum in der Region Charkiw ist die Zahl der Verletzten auf 15 gestiegen. Eine Person kam ums Leben, teilt die Militärverwaltung der Stadt auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Drones hit Russia’s Samara oil hub that blends Urals export crude—first strike there since 11 October
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff says the station blends a crude grade that makes up as much as half of Russia’s oil exports.

items.title: New support program helps farmers with demining and production recovery
items.teaser: The Ministry of Agrarian Policy and Food of Ukraine, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the United Nations World Food Program (WFP), is launching a new program to support farmers.

items.title: Russian bombs strike apartment building in Sloviansk, klling one and injuring six
items.teaser: Russian forces have carried out an airstrike using two FAB-250 bombs on the city center of Sloviansk, Donetsk region. One bomb struck a multi-story apartment building, killing a woman and injuring six people.

items.title: Kyiv plans new National Guard center to recruit foreigners. Front-line commander wants it built fast: half of them still come on donations
items.teaser: Ukraine is short of soldiers, yet foreign volunteers get little state help, according to the commander.

items.title: How Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria
items.teaser: Iliana Yotova won the presidential election in Bulgaria, promising to be a "president of peace." But the campaign showed how divided Bulgarians are about the war in Ukraine and drone attacks in the Black Sea.

items.title: Ukraine’s Armed Forces report record 2,500 Russian troops killed in one day
items.teaser: No sooner had October become the month with the highest enemy casualties since the start of Russia's invasion of Ukraine than, on November 1, the record for daily casualties was broken

items.title: HUR: Neuestes Kampfflugzeug explodiert auf Flugplatz im russischen Achhtubinsk
items.teaser: „Am 29. Oktober explodierte auf dem Gelände des russischen Militärflughafens "Achthubinsk" der modernste Mehrzweckjäger des Aggressorstaates -Su-57. Dies geschah beim Triebwerksstart. Der geschätzte Wert des Kampfflugzeugs liegt bei etwa 150 Millionen Dollar“, teilt der Militärgeheimdienst (HUR) mit.

items.title: Tender announced for 2027 food procurement for AFU
items.teaser: The Defense Procurement Agency (DOT) of the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine has announced a tender for the procurement of food products for 2027 for the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the State Special Transport Service, with an estimated value of UAH 43.8 billion.

items.title: Russia officially withdraws from European Anti-Torture Convention
items.teaser: On November 1, Russia officially withdrew from the European Convention for the Prevention of Torture. As a result, the Prevention of Torture and Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment (ECPT) will no longer be able to inspect places of detention in the country.

items.title: Russia exploits ceasefire to mask military movements, General Staff says
items.teaser: Russia used the humanitarian ceasefire in Oleshky to rotate soldiers, improve fighting positions, expand anti-drone netting on key logistics routes, and resupply soldiers with ammunition, Ukraine's General Staff said on Nov. 2.

items.title: Russian drone strikes facility in Bila Tserkva community in Kyiv region
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked a business in the Bila Tserkva community in Kyiv region using a drone.

items.title: HUR: Eight Chinese and four US manufacturers supply parts for Russia’s upgraded Gerbera drone. One with warhead already turned up on Poland’s coast
items.teaser: Russia’s throwaway drone gets a costly upgrade: anti-jam antennas, a camera watching for interceptors, and the range to cross Ukraine’s borders.

items.title: Russisches Militär wirft Gleitbomben auf Isjum ab - es gibt einen Toten und 11 Verletzte, die Stadt ist ohne Strom
items.teaser: Am Morgen des 2. Novembers hat die russische Armee die Stadt Isjum in der Region Charkiw mit gelenkten Fliegerbomben angegriffen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleh Synehubow, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian forces strike Chuhuiv district in Kharkiv region, several people injured
items.teaser: The Russian military attacked the village of Prymorske in the Pechenihy territorial community of Chuhuiv district, injuring two people.

items.title: Ein Toter und zwei Verletzte nach russischem Angriff auf Komyschuwacha in Region Saporischschja
items.teaser: Russischen Truppen haben am Morgen Komyschuwacha in der Region Saporischschja angegriffen, es gibt Opfer unter der Zivilbevölkerung, wie der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Mychajlo Semikin, auf Telegram mitteilt.

items.title: Verletzte nach russischen Angriffen in Regionen Schytomyr und Odessa, zivile und Energieinfrastruktur beschädigt
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat in der Nacht zum 2. November eine Energieanlage in der Region Odessa angegriffen, teilt der Energieversorger DTEK auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukraine can buy 500 Patriot missiles, but they may arrive only in years. One estimate says they’d last about three months
items.teaser: Kyiv asked for 100 Patriot interceptors a month and wants partners to send missiles from stock now, refilled later from the order.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 205 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, Pokrowsk am stärksten umkämpft
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 205 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell September 2026
18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Aktualisierung der Anhänge der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung
items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.title: Russian forces attack homes, energy, logistics infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, three injured
items.teaser: Two adults and a child were injured in Russian attacks on energy, logistics and civilian infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: A Non-Formalistic Application of the Law by the Dubai Court of Cassation
items.teaser: In two recent decisions, the Dubai Court of Cassation (“DCC”) has once again demonstrated an arbitration-friendly approach by upholding arbitration agreements that could have been declared void under a strict application of the law. The first decision ( DCC Challenge No. 1262/2025 (Commercial) ) relates to the requirem

items.title: Ukraine’s Air Alert app was warn of radiation, chemicals, and street fighting in Kyiv. None of it was real
items.teaser: Some warnings came in Russian and invoked the Oreshnik missile. The Air Force blamed likely enemy interference.

items.title: WSJ: US pushes to resume Russian gas supplies to Europe via Ukraine
items.teaser: The US is pushing for Russian gas supplies to Europe via Ukraine to resume as part of negotiations on an energy ceasefire, The Wall Street Journal reports.

items.title: Russian forces strike regional power utility facility in Odesa region
items.teaser: A power facility in the Odesa region came under an enemy attack overnight on November 2.

items.title: Ölanlage in der russischen Region Samara von Drohnen angegriffen
items.teaser: Am Morgen des 2. November haben Drohnen die russische Region Samara attackiert. Das Ziel des Angriffs sei die Linien-Produktions- und Dispatching-Station in der Nähe der Ortschaft Proswet gewesen, wie das Medium ASTRA berichtet.

items.title: Russia’s Starlink rival lost a second satellite after it apparently sat idle for 103 days
items.teaser: Most of the other 30 sit around 500 km, short of the 800 km target. Bureau 1440 hasn’t said whether it lowered the goal.

items.title: Russians strike hospital in Kherson with drone following end of ceasefire – video
items.teaser: Yaroslav Shanko has confirmed a Russian drone hit a hospital building in central Kherson around 07:40, causing structural damage but no casualties.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facility in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: Emergency and repair teams work flat out to restore electricity following a Russian attack on a DTEK facility in southern Ukraine.

items.title: CarthageProsecutor: Why were Ukrainska Pravda journalists really detained in Vienna?
Four injured in overnight Russian attack on Odesa
items.teaser: Four people were injured in a Russian attack on Odesa overnight on November 2.

items.title: Notabschaltungen der Stromversorgung in Kyjiw und mehreren weiteren Regionen
items.teaser: In einer Reihe ukrainischer Regionen sind Notabschaltungen der Stromversorgung veranlasst worden, teilt der Betreiber Ukrenerho auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Helping Mom out? How to send money to Ukraine from Canada
items.teaser: That's pretty much what the best way to send money to Ukraine looks like: one bank, one currency and no surprises. You just send the transfer, and the recipient can receive the money at a branch or in the app.

items.title: Ukraine’s and Russia’s ombudsmen agree to keep working on regular humanitarian missions after the Oleshky evacuation
items.teaser: Hundreds of civilians may still be inside the Russian-occupied Kherson Oblast town, and a journalist reports dozens of bodies were moved out.

items.title: Russen beschießen sechs Ortschaften und verletzen zwei Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 01. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk einen Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Drones attack Samara oil pumping station in Russia – media
items.teaser: Russia's Samara region came under a drone attack early on November 2. The likely target was the Samara Linear Production and Dispatch Station (LPDS) in the town of Prosvet, where a fire broke out following the attack.

items.title: One killed and several injured in Russian guided aerial bomb attack on Izium
items.teaser: A Russian guided aerial bomb strike on Izium kills one person, injures several others and completely cuts off electricity across the city.

items.title: Russia-friendly Yotova wins Bulgaria's presidential runoff
items.teaser: Iliana Yotova, who opposes military aid for Ukraine and calls for a dialogue with Moscow, won 57.58% of the Nov. 1 vote, with 99.95% of the polling station protocols processed.

items.title: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence reveals upgraded Gerbera drone with 1,200 km range
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence has revealed details of Russia's upgraded Gerbera-2 drone, which can fly up to 1,200 km and carry a warhead weighing up to 25 kg.

items.title: Generalstab: Russland verliert weitere 2500 Soldaten in den vergangenen 24 Stunden
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 592. 770 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 2500.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian attack on Vasyshcheve in Kharkiv region rises to 12
items.teaser: Twelve people, including a child, were injured in a Russian attack on the village of Vasyshcheve in the Kharkiv region on Sunday, November 1.

items.title: Latvian military deploys interceptor drone after unidentified drone violates its airspace
items.teaser: Latvia has activated an orange alert in eastern districts and deploys a Blaze interceptor drone after an unidentified UAV breaches its airspace.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,592,770 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,500 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Sky News films Russians bringing armour and infantry into Oleshky under cover of ceasefire – video
items.teaser: Drone footage obtained by Sky News shows Russian troops reinforcing positions, rotating forces and removing bodies during the Oleshky ceasefire.

items.title: War update: 205 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
items.teaser: A total of 205 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 1.
